title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。

title: KKR (KKR) Eyes $1 Billion Plus Medicover Hospitals India Deal
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 着眼于印度 10 亿美元加医疗保险医院交易
summary: KKR is reported to be in advanced talks to acquire a majority stake in Medicover Hospitals India. The potential deal could be valued at more than $1b and would expand KKR's healthcare platform in India.
summary_zh: 据报道，KKR 正在就收购印度 Medicover Hospitals 多数股权进行深入谈判。这笔潜在交易的价值可能超过 10 亿美元，并将扩大 KKR 在印度的医疗保健平台。
